rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for a highly skilled tradesperson or artisan.

example.english: This craftsman puts a lot of care into making wooden cabinets.
example.traditional: 呢位師傅整木櫃好有心機。
example.jyutping: nei1 wai6 si1 fu6 zing2 muk6 gwai6 hou2 jau5 sam1 gei1

rows.note: Use this for an artisan or artificer in a more formal or written context, especially when emphasizing skilled manual craft.

example.english: This craftsman has truly unmatched skills.
example.traditional: 呢位工匠嘅手藝真係無人能及。
example.jyutping: ni1 wai2 gung1 zoeng6 ge3 sau2 ngai6 zan1 hai6 mou4 jan4 nang4 kap6
